purpose: Records provenance for KeyOS Shield assets that were evaluated for Secure Notes scroll masking.
implementation_note: A partial content-width Shield port was evaluated and then removed from the active UI because production KeyOS Shield is a whole shell/backboard treatment, not a generic fade strip. The partial port produced visible rims, wedges, and incorrect clipping. Secure Notes currently uses plain clipped scroll frames. A future production-grade fix should migrate the full page shell to the production Shield/backboard model rather than reusing these assets as local overlays.

assets.usage_note: Retained for provenance only. The rejected partial port used this behind clipped scroll content with Slint nine-slice(64 64 96 64), matching the generated Images.nine-slice mapping in KeyOS.

removed_workaround.reason: Those assets baked the current page background into fade covers. Production KeyOS uses Shield background plus alpha-mask overlays instead, so the generated background-cover workaround is no longer active.
